_comment: Cycle 29. F42 established the condition: routing pays only when no member dominates every domain, and the Falcon council violates it (0W/0L twice). That council is therefore the right test bed for a per-question signal, because routing there is worth exactly nothing and any gain must come from the mechanism. TRIZ cell 28_37 produced stability-under-perturbation as a verifiable bid: a SECOND observation per player rather than a re-reading of the first, which is the one route F30's impossibility argument leaves open.
cost_units: GPU-hours; one day of GPU time trades against one nat
